title: Chapter 813
paragraphs: Chapter 813
Episode 203. The Decision of the Red Name Tribe
Alphen and Ballas started charging toward Jin, their eyes shining bright.
Jin, as well as the heads of the previous generations, were completely unaffected by the blood-sucking ability, driving Drack to madness.
'I must fight by absorbing as much blood as possible from the others and my kin. If I can't create an opportunity to use the return spell, it's over...!'
Of course, Jin had no intention of letting him do that.
"Blame Shymart and Rakiman. They taught me that you guys can turn your back at any moment."
Swish!

Bradamante left a huge gash on Drack's right foot. The eternal flame penetrated the wound, causing Drack to clench his teeth as if his jaw would break. Despite concentrating his brainwaves on the wound, the eternal flame remained undaunted like a brand.

"So, I should give you a lesson too. I will show you what happens when you rashly mess with the Vamel Alliance relying solely on your technology. So, give up on escaping through return magic or dimensional movement, and think of a way to die with a little bit of honor, as I said earlier."
"Shut up! I am the Great War King of the Red Name Tribe!"
"Exactly, that's what I wanted to see. You're finally getting the point. However, constantly absorbing other people's blood doesn't look good. Let's move a bit."

There were no civilians in the Kwachel Plains. The Dragon Castle had collapsed, and all the surviving dragon knights and dragons were safely evacuated by Dante, so there were no restrictions on using the battlefield.

'If Drack had invaded an area with many protectees, a massive slaughter or hostage situation would have been inevitable. We wouldn't have been able to suppress them like we are now, trying to protect civilians.'
Imagining that, Jin felt dizzy. Especially Drack, he had unique abilities specially tailored for massive slaughter, and for fighting superhuman warriors.

Giving them a lesson wasn't just an expression. It was necessary to inflict a terrible defeat on the Red Name Tribe so they couldn't even think about invading the Vamel Alliance again. If Drack returned alive, the Vamel Alliance would have to worry about this kind of terror every moment.
Crash, clank!

Every time Jin charged and swung his sword, Drack's massive body stumbled backward. The previous generation heads who had already approached from the left and right were pressuring his flanks, and Drack was retreating helplessly. Even after using the fortification, he couldn't make even a small counterattack.

He did try to counterattack from time to time. Expecting to be hit by the eternal flame, he swung his front paw, and when Jin jumped, he opened his mouth to crush him. Amplifying the cardiac light, he constantly shook the red nerves and red nerve-built spears around, and even shattered the ground with a roar.
However, he couldn't harm Jin in any way. On the contrary, every time he counterattacked, he was only cut or stabbed somewhere in his body by the swords of Jin and the previous heads.
Although it was futile, the only reason Drack could make such a counterattack was entirely thanks to his blood-sucking ability.

The fleet continued to regenerate through the blood it continuously absorbed. The regeneration was possible as not only the blood of the Redmei tribe, but also that of the Vamel Union superhumans was being absorbed.
However, even that was now coming to an end.
[Grandson! Now, we hardly see any blood being absorbed by him.]
[It seems like this is the limit, the range of his vampiric ability. It would have been extremely difficult to deal with if we weren't immune to vampirism.]
As Ballas and Alphen said, Drek could no longer steal blood from the fleet. His wounds healed noticeably slower than before, and his breath had a metallic sound.

"He would have been thrilled to fight just one Hedo. He must have thought that we would crumble or surrender if he brought us down one by one. But, we've defeated a strong enemy not long ago, an enemy incomparable to you."
For Drek, there was no means to resist anymore. He had already felt an insurmountable wall in facing just Jin alone, and with the presence of the superintendents, his power seemed infinitely pitiful.
Tsuahaak-!
As the sword energy passed through Drek's chest, a spray of blood spurted out. He decided it was pointless to maintain his transformed state and cancelled his transformation.

Drek, who returned to his Redmei form, held his spear and looked at his fleet far behind Jin. Even though Ballas and Alphen had left the battlefield earlier, the remaining members of the Vamel Union near the fleet didn't look exhausted.

If Drek's unique ability continued to affect the battlefield, the situation might have been slightly different, but there seemed to be no hope even for the fleet. Bale was intensifying solar power and pressuring the entire fleet, and Hedo, who rejoined the battlefield, was tearing the fleet apart just like in the beginning.
Victory was given up on at the beginning, and now it was Drek's turn to give up on escaping. He even wondered if any of his fellow men, including himself, could survive and return.

"Khhhh. So...... the sun must be reclaimed. Is the power that you guys have truly befitting of the inferior species called humans? After the death of the Sun God, this world has clearly lost its way."
"Well, you guys could be considered as followers of the Sun God too. Now that all hope has disappeared, are you looking for the God you believe in?"
"No. I don't think all possibilities have disappeared, Jin Runcandel. Let's make a deal. If you let me go, I'll offer you the knowledge of our Redmei."
Screech!
Drek saw his right arm, which had been attached until a moment ago, fall to the ground before he could finish his sentence.
"Deal, good. But if you wanted to make a deal, you should have come to me before doing all this. The Vamel Union does not and will not engage in any small negotiations with you."
Drek didn't look down at his fallen arm, but locked eyes with Jin. He felt that if he averted his gaze now, the next thing to fall wouldn't be his arm, but his neck.

"......Are you saying that because of your anger towards me, you're willing to give up the opportunity to drastically advance your technology? If it's about trust, I'll hand over the technology first. Even after receiving the technology, you wouldn't have to keep the promise. What I'm suggesting is a deal in which you have nothing to lose."
"That's a matter of perspective."

"I'll give you our fleet that's fighting behind your back. Without my command, you will never be able to fully possess that fleet. A self-destruction device to prevent technology leakage is built-in. There are limitations in analyzing technology just from the wreckage."
Jin swung his sword again, severing Dreke's left arm. Dreke dared not avoid Jin's gaze again.
"......What do you want, Jin Runcandel? Since you're not entirely against the deal, you're not killing me outright. Let me know, I'll do anything that I can fulfill."
The technology of the Zhegmeng clan was indeed tempting.

However, Jin was certain that if Dreke was left alive, he would inevitably trick them. There are many unknown parts of the Zhegmeng clan's technology, so there's a high possibility that Dreke would pretend to help the Vamel Alliance while plotting to escape.

"The reason I'm not killing you right now is simple. I think there are people among those on that ship who are recording this situation. Whether it's in writing or video. All I want is for this to be fully conveyed to your base. To make them fear me more."
Jin stepped closer to Dreke. Dreke unconsciously stepped back.
Just like how Rakiman instilled absolute fear in the beastmen, Jin was engraving his existence into the Zhegmeng.
A perception that they absolutely should not fight against - the 'natural enemy'.
"Now you know what you have to say last, Dreke Hon. If you really care about the ones you call your fellow clansmen."
Jin grabbed Dreke's shoulder and said. The fear he was feeling was being transmitted through his palm.
Finally, Dreke, having given up, cried out.
My fellow clansmen!
Never challenge Jin Runcandel and the Vamel Alliance again, we can never beat them...!
Unless our god returns.

Dreke held back the rest of his words, tears of blood pouring from his eyes. Dreke had been sucking up the blood of other Zhegmeng throughout the battle, planning to use it as a catalyst for a return spell.
But he truly believed that his fellow clansmen should not repeat this mistake. Until their god returns, they shouldn't even dare approach the Vamel Alliance.

Dreke's use of his fellow clansmen as expendables during the battle was for the sake of the 'Zhegmeng'. The Zhegmeng are an extreme totalitarian group, and Dreke was particularly fanatical among them.
"You're right. Now, let me free you from this humiliation."
Ahhhh......!
Drekk's body, soaked in immortality, was suddenly and fiercely burning. In such a way, engulfed in blue flames, Drekk met his end.

"Let's go and clean up the remnants now, ancestors. Since the image of Drekk recorded by the fleet will be delivered by the ones who escape through the Return spell, I will make sure to destroy the red fleet completely without leaving a single one."
[Ah, our great-grandson. It's just like watching my youth!]
[I would imagine the feeling of the 57th's youth would be entirely different from mine.]
[20th, it's bold of you to speak like that right after losing the bet.]
[Don't you see the remaining ships? You'd have wanted to finish with one more ship destroyed than me, but sadly, the game is still on.]
[Hehehe! Excellent, give it your all. The result will be the same anyway. Let's go!]
And so, the Zekma tribe had to lose a single person, the Grand Combat King and his entire fleet, all due to a single invasion by the Vamel Alliance.
{My people! Never challenge Jin Lun Kundel and the Vamel Alliance again, we, can never defeat them...!}
A video capturing Drekk's last moments was being transmitted to every Zekma castle where the seal was lifted. The Zekma who watched the video were shaking, feeling humiliated and terrified.
No one expected not only that Drekk Hon and the red fleet would be wiped out, but also that such a video would remain.
"What on earth… Drekk… brother… to this extent..."
"It's manipulation! They have a profession called a record magician. The video is manipulated with a trick called recording magic…!"
Among the various words exchanged, Shimat clenched his teeth and looked at his tribesmen.

"Haven't you heard the testimonies of the ones who returned by the Return spell, that's Drekk's sincere last will. We... from now on, we must follow Drekk's will. Never, never again! We must not mess with the Vamel Alliance. It has been proven that it is the quickest way to our Zekma's extinction."
From now on, our Zekma will only target Zipfel and Kinzelo. Until our god returns and all the Great Combat Kings regain their full power.
As Shimat continued his sentence, he made up his mind. The arrogant Combat Kings kept driving their tribesmen into the slaughter, blocking the resurgence of Zekma.

'Maybe, it's a blessing in disguise. This event must have made the remaining Combat King tribesmen realize the dangers of Jin Lun Kundel and the Vamel Alliance. My words have been proven right, now it's time to concentrate on the hunt excluding those monsters.'
Shimat immediately requested communication with the Combat Kings and expressed his opinion.
{Yeah, brother Shimat is right. We will completely exclude the Vamel Alliance from the invasion targets for the time being.}
{Wow… I never thought brother Drekk would be shattered like that. I agree, if we keep rushing at them, there won't be any tribesmen left. It's surprising that brother Rakiman is still alive.}
The Combat Kings decided without hesitation. Victory and defeat, the Vamel Alliance and the Zekma's fortunes were diverging.
